name: Angelnet
summary: Nationwide dialup + ADSL + hosting ISP (brand 'AngelNET Internet', 1300 780 949); live c. 2003-2005, domain parked/dead by 2013.

events.details: Dialup + ADSL + hosting, brand 'AngelNET Internet', national 1300 780 949 line; earliest angelnet.com.au Wayback capture 26 Dec 2003.

Same 'AngelNET Internet' homepage captured unchanged Dec 2003 - Jan 2005; no captures 2005-2013, then the domain returns only redirects/errors (301 in 2013, 403 in 2014-16, 500 in 2021) - parked/dead by 2013.

The current ANGELNET PTY LTD (ACN 660 128 656, ABN 72 660 128 656, Parramatta NSW) was registered only 13 Jun 2022 and is unrelated to this c. 2003 ISP - a coincidental name match, not the same entity.
